text:
{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Achieve 20% revenue growth for FY26",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "This year we have given a guidance of 20% growth for the full year and we are going to achieve it",
      "outcome": "FY26 revenue was ₹6,569 Cr vs ₹5,832 Cr in FY25, representing 12.6% growth.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Annual Financials Mar 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Adhesive EBITDA margin stable at 15% to 16%",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "EBITDA margin is also very stable and moving in the range of 15% to 16% continuously. We are confident that this run rate will continue",
      "outcome": "Adhesive India margin fell to 12.2% in Q1 FY27 and UK margin was 4.9%.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Double digit margin for UK business in FY27",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "we said for the next year we are predicting that the double digit margin will be there",
      "outcome": "UK EBITDA margin was 7.33% in Q2 FY26 and 4.9% in Q1 FY27.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2025 / Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Double fire pipe sales in FY27",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "Last year we've doubled our sale in fire pipes and we are looking to double that sale this year as well.",
      "outcome": "Export volume growth doubled, but specific fire pipe sales for FY27 are not yet reported.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "May 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "CPVC plant construction completion by September 2026",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "we will be finishing the installation of machinery and construction of the CPVC plant by next year, by September 2026",
      "outcome": "In Aug 2026, management revised completion to December end with trials in Q4 FY27.",
      "verdict": "partly",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 call guidance"
    },
    {
      "promise": "FY27 value growth of more than 20%",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "our value growth for the full year will be more than 20%, in top line.",
      "outcome": "H1 FY27 consolidated revenue is ₹3,566 Cr; Q2 FY27 YoY growth was 26%.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2026 call reported metrics / Quarterly financials"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Plumbing EBITDA margin between 16% to 18%",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "we will be definitely going to be in the range of 16% to 18%.",
      "outcome": "Plumbing EBITDA margin was 18.9% in Q1 FY27 and 17.4% for H1 FY27.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 / Nov 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "PEX machine trials and production by end of September 2026",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "By end of September, all trials will be over and the commercial production of the same will be made.",
      "outcome": "Not specifically confirmed in Nov 2026 reported metrics, though other capex was noted as on schedule.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2026 call"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 1,
    "partly": 1,
    "missed": 3,
    "summary": "Management tends to over-promise on growth and margins. They missed the 20% FY26 growth target and have consistently struggled to meet guided adhesive and UK margins."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Management claimed 20% growth for FY26, but annual financials show only 12.6% growth was achieved.",
    "The narrative of 'stable' 15-16% adhesive margins diverged from reality as margins dropped to 12.2% in India and 4.9% in the UK.",
    "Plumbing margins align well with narrative, staying within or above the 16-18% guided range in H1 FY27.",
    "Revenue growth narrative improved in Q2 FY27, with the 26% YoY increase finally exceeding the 20% target threshold."
  ]
}
